response.justification: Bogdan is a highly accomplished senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years of experience, a CS degree, and deep expertise in testing, architecture, and agile craftsmanship — far beyond what an entry-level Java role requires. The two decisive mismatches are seniority (severe overqualification creates high flight risk and salary misalignment for a junior IC position) and language: the role explicitly requires strong verbal and written German for client-facing insurance consulting, while his German is listed as Basic. Java also appears only peripherally in his stack (robotic arms and device orchestration at Altom, 2016–2018), with his recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. He would be a strong candidate for a senior opening at the company, but not for this posting.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and cloud
Strong agile/craftsmanship background: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development
CS degree, Berlin-based, and proven client collaboration plus teaching/mentoring track record
concerns: German is only Basic; role requires strong written and verbal German
Massively overqualified for an entry-level position — retention and compensation risk
Java is a minor, dated part of his stack; recent work is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang
